data.description: Found in v0.58.0 staging smoke (Release artifact, com.stage11.c11.staging). (1) c11 set-status writes the sidebar display store but NOT SurfaceMetadataStore: no metadata.changed event, no last-updated, so TEL age/decay and EVT status events never apply to the command agents actually use; set-metadata --key status works correctly (event observed). set-progress/log likely same seam - audit all fast-path telemetry commands. (2) Derived liveness (TEL-3/4, EVT-2): no liveness.derived events, no derived metadata key, no visible UI state after minutes of PTY output on a surface with a registered agent. Determine whether the deriver runs at all in Release and where its output goes (SidebarActivityProjector?). Fix on branch release/v0.58.0. Acceptance: on a rebuilt staging artifact, set-status produces a metadata.changed event with last-updated and the pill decays (accelerated TTL ok); PTY output produces liveness.derived transitions observable via events tail; both captured as recorded proof. Repro notes in this ticket's comments.
data.title: v0.58.0 staging blocker: set-status fast path bypasses evented metadata store; derived liveness not observable

data.body: Repro (staging instance, C11_SOCKET=/tmp/c11-staging.sock, bundle CLI at Contents/Resources/bin/c11): set-status --workspace workspace:1 --surface surface:1 working 'x' -> OK, sidebar shows text, but get-metadata has no status key and events tail shows nothing. set-metadata --key status --value working -> metadata.changed event seq 8, source=explicit. Liveness: set-agent + 'for i in 1..6; do echo tick; sleep 1; done' -> zero liveness events, no derived key in get-metadata. Screenshot: staging-smoke.png (scratchpad). Staging app relaunched with C11_SOCKET_MODE=automation for CLI access.

Both defects fixed on branch ts/c11-171 → PR #326 (base release/v0.58.0). Stopping at pr_open.

Root causes (confirmed against code + live event logs — liveness.derived had fired 3x ever, all in one C11-167 dev instance, zero in staging/prod):
1. set-status/set-progress wrote only the tab-scoped display store, never SurfaceMetadataStore → no metadata.changed event, no canonical ts. Fix: mirror canonical keys (status/task/role/model/progress) into the evented store at .explicit (targeting explicit --surface, resolved by the CLI, or the focused surface). Threading preserved (no new main.sync).
2. Shell integration reports report_shell_state --tab=$CMUX_TAB_ID, and CMUX_TAB_ID is the SURFACE uuid, but explicitSocketScope treated --tab as the workspace → tabManagerFor(surfaceUUID)=nil → silent no-op, deriver never reached. Fix: resolve the workspace from the panel via workspaceContainingPanel(), through a pure resolveShellActivityTarget helper, in both v1 + v2 shell-state handlers.

Validation:
- c11-logic: 1261 passed (1 unrelated flaky perf benchmark, CommandPaletteSearchEngineTests). New tests cover the resolver contract + canonical-mirror key selection/ts/event emission.
- RELEASE staging rebuild (rel-v0.58.0-fix2 via reloads.sh), recorded proof in notes/c11-171-proof-*.txt:
  (a) set-status status → metadata.changed (seq 14, source=explicit) + canonical status key with last-updated ts.
  (b) PTY output burst → liveness.derived working (seq 15) → idle (seq 17) on the driven surface.

Post-merge: run scripts/sync-installed-skills.sh c11 (metadata.md reference updated; not synced pre-merge).

data.reason: PR #326 open against release/v0.58.0; c11-logic green + RELEASE staging proof captured. Stopping at pr_open, awaiting review/merge.
